news_articles.title: Former editor, publisher of Business Insurance Kathryn McIntyre dies
news_articles.snippet: Spending 25 years at the publication, Ms. McIntyre, 71, joined Business Insurance when it was a fortnightly publication and helped lead it through its transformation to a weekly news magazine and later a digital and print publishing platform.

news_articles.title: Next adds excess liability coverage
news_articles.snippet: Insurtech Next Insurance Inc. has added umbrella and excess liability to its range of coverages for small businesses.

news_articles.title: Sarah Joins The Henshalls Team
news_articles.snippet: At Henshalls, Sarah will join the Business Insurance team and work with commercial clients across a whole range of industry sectors.

news_articles.title: Business Insurance seeks input on risk technology | Business Insurance
news_articles.snippet: Business Insurance has launched its annual risk management technology survey.

news_articles.title: ‘Business Insurance’ Names Acrisure Partner a “Women to Watch” Winner
news_articles.snippet: Business Insurance started the Women to Watch program in 2006 to recognize women leaders doing outstanding work in risk management and commercial insurance.
